tha-ap514:1.1: Kapiṭṭhaphaladāyaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / rathiyaṃ paṭipajjantaṃ kapiṭṭhaṃ adadaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap514:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap514:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kapiṭṭhaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
